title: NSE IPO: Market dominance vs regulatory risks; what investors should know from the RHP
text: NSE IPO: Market dominance vs regulatory risks; what investors should know from the RHP. In its red herring prospectus (RHP), NSE has highlighted its market leadership, scale, profitability, technology infrastructure and cash generation as key strengths. The exchange, however, has also flagged several risks, including dependence on trading volumes, regulatory changes and increased scrutiny.
